## Workflow error alert (email)

1. Import and save this workflow.
2. In **Configuration (EDIT ME)** replace alertEmailFrom / alertEmailTo. Optionally set n8nBaseUrl (for example https://n8n.example.com); empty means no execution link.
3. Select your **SMTP credential** in **Send Email**. Credentials are not included in this export.
4. In each monitored workflow, open **Settings → Error Workflow**, select this workflow and save (receive-invoices, Sellf, WooCommerce, or any other workflow). This error workflow does not need activation.

Email contains only workflow/node names, error name/message (up to 500 characters), alert time (UTC), execution ID and optional link. Trigger errors may have no execution ID or node name. X-Api-Key and Bearer patterns are redacted before truncation; arbitrary sensitive text is not guaranteed to be detected.

No node inputs/outputs, headers, stack traces, context or attachments are forwarded. Execution saving is disabled. Error Trigger runs for automatic failures, not manual tests or handled errors; SMTP failures need separate monitoring.
